runtimeLicenseBoundary: PDF.js and qcms runtime code remains external under its own licenses. The new host adapter is MIT. No runtime modules/fonts/CMaps are included.
backend: Custom Node Canvas host adapter, not native browser Canvas. Engine source unchanged.
wasmLoad: Minimal XMLHttpRequest host adapter only allows synchronous GET of this exact local runtime qcms_bg.wasm file, returning its bytes. No network or arbitrary paths; no engine-internal patch.
limitations: This adapter targets self-contained original ICC controls without external fonts/CMaps. It is not a browser implementation or proof of general Node/browser parity. DeviceCMYK still uses polynomial fallback when no explicit ICCBased profile is supplied.
